ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Days of Rage: Vietnam, 1968, and the Fall of the Presidency. Description: This course explores conflict American History through the Reacting to the Past program, in which students enact roles as historical figures in weeks-long games designed to immerse you in historical moments, focusing on the 1960s/1970s, a period of intense turmoil with civil rights, the war in Vietnam, and the fall of the Nixon presidency. Our first game takes place in 1968 Chicago at the DNC Convention with the convergence of a fractured political party and the role of protest in American politics. Then we pivot to 1973-1974 with the Watergate scandal and Nixon administration. We will grapple with a constitutional crisis, as we navigate burglaries, investigative reporters, and the role of secret tapes from the Oval Office. Come and explore changing gender and social roles and the place of political protest as different ideologies clash against each other to remake a broken society.
